title: 第2676章 雪天撑伞会很帅第2675章 第二条龙脉
lines: 宁宸抬眸，无语地看着谢司羽。
“谢师兄，能不能把伞放下来，屋子里打伞不吉利！”
伞在某些祭祀活动中，是用来招魂的东西，所以在屋子里打伞，会被视为不吉利。
当然，宁宸倒是没有这方面的顾虑，只是单纯觉得谢司羽太累，天天撑个伞，胳膊不酸吗？
谢司羽酷酷地说道：“这是营帐，不是屋子，几不吉利无所谓，帅就行。”
宁宸嘴角狠狠地抽出了几下。
“谢师兄，请坐！”
谢司羽落座，依旧打着伞。
宁宸无奈摇头，“谢师兄，星儿给你设计这把伞的时候，是忘了设计合上的功能了吗？”
“她没忘，只是我没用过。”
宁宸彻底服了，扯出一个你赢了的表情。
“宋知玄的脚没事。”
谢司羽突然来了一句，但宁宸并不意外，挑眉道：“然后呢？”
“他假装崴了脚，让其他人先回，留下两个士兵陪着他，缓了一会儿，说自己脚好多了，以上厕所为由，去了龙首的位置，但那里有重兵把守，他便退了回来。”
宁宸低头思忖，当灵阳子说宋知玄崴了脚，落在了后面，宁宸便吩咐萧颜汐去找谢司羽，由谢司羽暗中去查探。
龙脉关系重大，不容有失。
宁宸不是个容易相信别的人，被人害多了，疑心很重。
虽然宋知玄帮他解决了宿州龙脉的问题，但这不足以让宁宸真正相信他，因为宋知玄出现得太过巧合。
就算没有宋知玄，他一样可以找到解决宿州龙脉问题的人，大不了请老天师出手。
老天师虽然没了修为，但见识还在，风水堪舆也是拿手。
只是他没了修为，年纪大了，宁宸不愿意让他再辛劳奔波，让他留在王府养老。
冯奇正说过他不喜欢宋知玄，老冯是个很单纯的人，所以看人看事的角度很清奇，有时候反而比心思复杂的人更能看清真相。
其实说白了，宋知玄，静渊山人，灵阳子这些人，宁宸全都不信。
如果真的相信其中一方，就不会让三方人马竞争了。
目前，最重要的是解决问题。
不管这些人是好是坏，怀着什么心思，只要能让龙脉恢复就行···正所谓不管黑猫白猫，抓住老鼠的就是好猫。
因为宁宸自己，心思也不单纯。
三方人马，相互牵制。
他们之间不合，一方人马居心叵测，在恢复龙脉的事情上动手脚，另外两方必然能看出来。
九道龙脉恢复，事成之后，这三方人马，要么归顺朝廷，世代为朝廷卖命，要么全部死。
因为他们接触过龙脉，而龙脉事关大玄江山社稷。
宁宸给谢司羽倒了杯茶，“辛苦师兄了！”
谢司羽端起茶杯抿了一口，摇头道：“不辛苦，还要继续盯着吗？”
宁宸点头，“那辛苦师兄了！”
“外面下雪了！”
宁宸怔了一下，“什么意思？”
谢司羽放下茶杯，站起身朝着外面走去，背对着宁宸酷酷地说道：“雪天撑伞···会很帅！”
宁宸怔了怔，扶额苦笑，谢司羽同意盯着宋知玄，不是因为别的，只是因为雪中撑伞很帅。
谢师兄的中二病越来越严重了！
content_en:
Ning Chen raised his eyes and looked at Xie Siyu speechlessly.
"Thank you, senior brother, can you put down your umbrella? It's unlucky to hold an umbrella in the house!"
Umbrellas are used to summon spirits in some ritual activities, so holding an umbrella in the house is considered unlucky.
Of course, Ning Chen didn't have any worries in this regard. He just felt that Xie Siyu was too tired. He held an umbrella every day. Aren't his arms sore?
Xie Siyu said coolly: "This is a tent, not a house. It doesn't matter how unlucky it is, as long as it's handsome."
Ning Chen twitched the corner of his mouth several times.
"Thank you, senior brother, please sit down!"
Xie Siyu sat down, still holding an umbrella.
Ning Chen shook his head helplessly, "Xie Senior Brother, when Xing'er designed this umbrella for you, did he forget to design the closing function?"
"She hasn't forgotten it, but I haven't used it."
Ning Chen was completely convinced and made a winning expression.
"Song Zhixuan's feet are fine."
Xie Siyu said something suddenly, but Ning Chen was not surprised. He raised his eyebrows and said, "What next?"
"He pretended to have a sprained foot and let the others go back first, leaving two soldiers to accompany him. After a while, he said that his foot was much better and went to the dragon's head as an excuse to go to the toilet, but there was a heavy guard there, so he retreated."
Ning Chen lowered his head and thought. When Lingyangzi said that Song Zhixuan had sprained his foot and was lagging behind, Ning Chen ordered Xiao Yanxi to find Xie Siyu, and Xie Siyu went to investigate secretly.
Dragon Vein is of great importance and cannot be lost.
Ning Chen is not someone who trusts others easily. He has been hurt by many people and is very suspicious.
Although Song Zhixuan helped him solve the problem of Suzhou Dragon Veins, it was not enough for Ning Chen to truly believe him because Song Zhixuan's appearance was too coincidental.
Even without Song Zhixuan, he could still find someone to solve the Suzhou dragon vein problem, or at worst, ask the Heavenly Master to take action.
Although Lao Tianshi has lost his cultivation, his knowledge is still there, and he is also good at Feng Shui Kanyu.
It's just that he has lost his cultivation and is getting old. Ning Chen is not willing to let him work hard anymore and lets him stay in the palace for retirement.
Feng Qizheng said that he didn't like Song Zhixuan. Old Feng was a very simple person, so he had a very unique perspective on people and things, and sometimes he could see the truth more clearly than people with complicated minds.
In fact, to put it bluntly, Ning Chen didn't believe in Song Zhixuan, Jingyuanshanren, Lingyangzi and all these people.
If we really believed in one of them, we would not let the three parties compete.
At the moment, the most important thing is to solve the problem.
No matter whether these people are good or bad, or what their intentions are, as long as they can restore the dragon's veins... As the saying goes, it doesn't matter whether the cat is black or white, as long as it catches mice, it is a good cat.
Because Ning Chen himself is not simple-minded.
The three parties restrained each other.
There is a disagreement between them. If one party has ulterior motives and is trying to manipulate the matter of restoring the dragon's veins, the other two parties will definitely be able to see it.
After the nine dragon veins are restored, these three parties will either surrender to the imperial court and serve the imperial court for generations, or they will all die.
Because they have come into contact with dragon veins, and dragon veins are related to Daxuan Jiangshan Sheji.
Ning Chen poured a cup of tea for Xie Siyu, "Thank you for your hard work, senior brother!"
Xie Siyu picked up the teacup and took a sip, shook his head and said, "It's not hard, do you still want to keep staring?"
Ning Chen nodded, "Thank you for your hard work, senior brother!"
"It's snowing outside!"
Ning Chen was stunned for a moment, "What do you mean?"
Xie Siyu put down his tea cup, stood up and walked outside. With his back to Ning Chen, he said coolly: "It will look cool to hold an umbrella in the snow..."
Ning Chen was stunned, holding his forehead and smiling bitterly. Xie Siyu agreed to stare at Song Zhixuan, not because of anything else, but because holding an umbrella in the snow looked cool.
Senior Brother Xie’s secondary disease is getting more and more serious!
title_en: Chapter 2676: Holding an umbrella on a snowy day will look cool Chapter 2675: The second dragon vein
